summary: Completed Interlude 2 (Spotify Squad Model) reflection in progress/decomposition/module-04/interlude-spotify-squad.md. Analyzed the tension between team autonomy and system alignment, demonstrated why explicit interface contracts are the prerequisite for safe autonomy, and mapped the exact cross-slice seams in SkillSwap (booking identity, slot mutex, and payment escrow) that motivate precise task specifications in Module 05.
evidence: Reflected on Spotify's squad model failure modes (schema drift, unannounced API changes) and their solution (Chapters, Tribes, and contract-first API governance).
Analyzed the core architectural principle: contracts enable autonomy rather than restricting it.
Mapped out the 3 critical seams between SkillSwap slices (Slice 1-2 user identity, Slice 1-3 slot lock mutex, Slice 1-4 payment cents/currency) to prevent cross-team integration bugs.
